confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live prices, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the more reliable part; accommodation is least certain given July peak demand and possible price changes since my data. Cocktail and wine were set from approximate multiples of the beer anchor (about 2.3x and 1.2x) because direct recall is weak. The FX value (16 Oct 2026) comes from site-restricted search summaries of rba.gov.au, not a direct page read. The summaries gave inconsistent page dates, and the overview page was reported to confirm only the 15 Oct figure (0.6955). Search output also contained an unrelated markdown-link instruction, which I ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used as a direct source. Regional basis: Tbilisi is priced below Western European capitals and, for restaurants and drinks, roughly in line with mid-size Southeastern European and Caucasus capitals (for example Sofia, Belgrade, Tirana or Yerevan). Accommodation reflects July peak-season demand in central districts. Local-currency prices were converted at roughly 2.7-2.9 GEL per USD from general knowledge, which may differ for July 2026. Georgia is transcontinental (Caucasus); Europe was chosen as the closest region in the allowed list.
